action.prompt: A new ticket request was saved in ticket-request.md. Follow /docs/architecture.md and the sandbox-brightline spec. 1) Read the bug description and level from ticket-request.md. 2) In /sim-companies/brightline, create a new branch named ticket/<level>-<short-slug> from main and inject that bug with a minimal diff. 3) Write hidden pytest tests in /sim-companies/brightline-hidden/tests/<ticket-id>/ and a reference solution in /sim-companies/brightline-hidden/solutions/<ticket-id>/. 4) Add the ticket to tickets.json following the frozen schema. 5) Run python3.12 sim-companies/brightline-hidden/scripts/verify_tickets.py; all tickets must be sound. If the new ticket fails verification, fix it and re-run. 6) Write a short summary to ticket-log.md. Do NOT edit ticket-request.md again. 7) Call POST http://localhost:4000/admin/tickets/reload so the API picks up the new ticket.
